w:r.w:t: The Local Fund Audit Department began functioning as a separate department as per G.O.Ms.No.609, Finance Department, dated 22.03.1880. Subsequently, the department was placed under the administrative control of the District Collector as per G.O.Ms.No.514, Finance Department, dated 10.03.1885, and functioned under such control from 1885 to 1920.
